plain_english: Gaze at her, at śakti, with a light sealing of the breath; this is the sign pointed out — beyond it lies raising.
sanskrit_cite: tāmevālokayec chaktiṃ manāk kumbhakavṛttinā / etal lakṣaṇam uddiṣṭam utthāpanam ataḥ param

plain_english: On the practiced out-breath, utter the mantra; contemplate her awakened — the Supreme Goddess, straight as a staff.
sanskrit_cite: juṣadrecakavṛttyā tu mantraṃ caiva samuccaret / prabuddhāṃ cintayecchaktiṃ daṇḍavat parameśvarīm

plain_english: Come from the heart of the base, she has entered the suṣumnā road; this is raising declared — beyond it, awakening.
sanskrit_cite: ādhāramadhyādāyātā suṣumnāmārgam āśritā / utthāpanaṃ samākhyātaṃ bodhanaṃ paratastathā

plain_english: Rooted in the bulb, pierce the navel, then the grandsire in the heart; in the throat the unfallen one, Rudra face to face on the palate's floor.
sanskrit_cite: kandastho vedhayen nābhiṃ tato hṛtsthaṃ pitāmaham / kaṇṭhasthamacyutaṃ sākṣādrudraṃ tālutale sthitam

plain_english: At the brow's middle, Īśa; at the door of brahman, Sadāśiva; wake them and rise swiftly to the state that rests on nothing — Śiva.
sanskrit_cite: bhruvormadhyagataṃ tv īśaṃ brahmadvāre sadāśivam / bodhayitvā vrajed āśu padaṃ cānāśritaṃ śivam

plain_english: This awakening is pointed out. Then the resting in the wheels: a petal by nature, blazing, flowing, like the steady sky.
sanskrit_cite: etadbodhanam uddiṣṭaṃ cakraviśrāmaṇaṃ tataḥ / svābhāvikaṃ dalaṃ dīptaṃ dravaṃ sthiranabhopamam

plain_english: Nectar, the crest, śakti-brahmā — and the drop-sound: so the twelvefold wheel is proclaimed, says tradition.
sanskrit_cite: amṛtaṃ śekharaṃ caiva śaktirbrahmā tathaiva ca / bindunādaṃ tathā proktaṃ cakradvādaśakaṃ kila

plain_english: Piercing in turn — śakti in wheel after wheel, at every instant — she, the Great Goddess, comes to rest: the supreme wheel-rest.
sanskrit_cite: vedhayantī kramāc chaktiścakre cakre pratikṣaṇam / viśramet sā mahādevī cakraviśrāma uttamaḥ

plain_english: First the heart trembles, and the palate gate; his head spins — the sign of the sight's crossing over.
sanskrit_cite: hṛdayaṃ kampate pūrvaṃ tālukadvārameva ca / śiraśca bhramate tasya dṛṣṭisaṃkrāntilakṣaṇam

plain_english: It sets each limb spinning, joint by joint; his heart churns — such is the power of true knowing.
sanskrit_cite: ekaikaṃ bhramayaty aṅgam aṅgapratyaṅgasaṃdhiṣu / ghūrṇate hṛdayaṃ cāsya samyagvidyāprabhāvataḥ
